candidates.title: _calculateLiquidation penalty interpolation can underflow for high collateral-factor positions
candidates.description: In the fullValue>=maxPenaltyValue branch, startLiquidationValue=debt*fullValue/collateralValue and the term (startLiquidationValue - maxPenaltyValue) is used as a denominator/subtraction. For a high collateralFactor (collateralValue close to fullValue) startLiquidationValue approaches debt, which can be < maxPenaltyValue=debt*(1+maxPenalty) → underflow revert, blocking liquidation.

candidates.title: Oracle spot-price cross-check enables liquidation DoS via atomic pool manipulation
candidates.description: V3Oracle.getValue cross-checks the Chainlink-derived price against the Uniswap pool SPOT price (_getReferencePoolPriceX96(pool,0)); a divergence beyond maxPoolPriceDifference reverts. An attacker can atomically move spot to trip this and block liquidation of an unhealthy position (the value itself is Chainlink-based and not inflated).

candidates.title: Griefing: repeated spot manipulation prevents timely liquidation → protocol bad debt
candidates.description: Combines ORA-001: a borrower keeps their own underwater position un-liquidatable by re-tripping the oracle spot cross-check, while interest accrues and value declines, pushing loss onto lenders (violates 'debt <= lent assets' over time).

candidates.title: Liquidation DoS via atomic pool-spot manipulation in _checkPoolPrice
candidates.description: getValue cross-checks the Chainlink-derived price against the Uniswap pool SPOT price (_getReferencePoolPriceX96(pool,0), twapSeconds=0). A divergence > maxPoolPriceDifference reverts the whole getValue, so an attacker who atomically moves spot can block liquidation of an unhealthy loan (value itself is Chainlink-based, not inflated).

candidates.title: L2 Chainlink sequencer-uptime check not confirmed (multi-chain deploy)
candidates.description: _getReferenceTokenPriceX96 enforces feed staleness (maxFeedAge) but the presence of an L2 sequencer-uptime feed check is unconfirmed at this depth. README states deploy on any EVM chain → on L2s a stale-after-restart price would be accepted.

candidates.title: transform() performs arbitrary call to whitelisted transformer with NFT approved and health deferred
candidates.description: transform() approves the position NFT to a whitelisted transformer and executes transformer.call(data) before the end-of-call health check; vault state (transformedTokenId) enables transform-mode borrow that sends funds to msg.sender. A buggy/over-permissive transformer or crafted external-swap calldata (README attack idea) is the concentrated risk; the transformedTokenId guard blocks re-entering transform itself.

candidates.title: Reserve-shortfall democratization uses stale in-memory lend rate for cleanup
candidates.description: _handleReserveLiquidation lowers lastLendExchangeRateX96 in storage on a reserve shortfall but returns nothing; liquidate() continues with the old state.newLendExchangeRateX96 for _cleanupLoan/_sendPositionValue.

candidates.title: Review needed: lend share/asset rounding direction and first-depositor inflation on V3Vault
candidates.description: V3Vault implements ERC4626 over a lend exchange rate (lastLendExchangeRateX96). previewDeposit/Mint/Withdraw/Redeem and _convertToShares/_convertToAssets use Math.Rounding; need to confirm every user-facing path rounds in the vault's favor and that the exchange-rate model avoids classic first-depositor share inflation (no virtual shares observed). Not fully traced.

candidates.title: Collateral-value-limit counts full debt against BOTH pair tokens
candidates.description: _updateAndCheckCollateral adds the full (newShares-oldShares) to tokenConfigs[token0].totalDebtShares AND token1's, then checks each against its own collateralValueLimitFactor. A position's debt is counted in full under both of its tokens' limits.

candidates.title: Review: setOracleMode / Automator operator & withdrawer / _validateOwner all properly gated
candidates.description: Reviewed the privileged surface: V3Oracle.setOracleMode requires owner||emergencyAdmin (line 250); Automator setOperator/setWithdrawer/setVault are onlyOwner; _validateOwner enforces owner==msg.sender and msg.sender not a vault; transform requires loan owner or per-tokenId approval. No missing-auth issue found at this depth. transformApprovals are per (owner,tokenId,target) — scope looks correct.

candidates.title: Review: FlashloanLiquidator atomic-liquidation flow
candidates.description: FlashloanLiquidator does atomic liquidation via a Uniswap V3 flashloan and swap; it is a permissionless convenience util (liquidator pays cost, gets collateral, repays flashloan). Reviewed entry: callback must verify the flashloan pool caller. No protocol-fund exposure beyond the liquidate() it wraps. Not fully traced.

candidates.title: Permit2 signature-transfer paths in deposit/repay/liquidate; FoT/rebasing explicitly unsupported
candidates.description: deposit/mint/repay/liquidate accept Permit2 permitData (ISignatureTransfer.permitTransferFrom). FoT/rebasing tokens are out of scope (README: usage reverts). Reviewed: permit2 transfers pull liquidatorCost/deposit amount directly; signature is user-supplied to move their own funds. No third-party permit-front-running surfaced at this depth.
